title: Coarsen SIRead predicate-lock granularity to cut per-txn lock bookkeeping
configuration_cause: max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2 force fine-grained SIRead lock retention; with 5 terminals and zero lock waits, the residual cost is per-transaction predicate-lock bookkeeping (locks_total median 339, p95 1974) rather than blocking.
mechanism: SERIALIZABLE retries are zero (server_retry_ratio=0.0, rollback_ratio=0.0) and lock_waiting_backends stays 0, so predicate locks are not causing waits; they are causing per-transaction lock churn. Raising max_pred_locks_per_page from 2 to 8 and max_pred_locks_per_relation from -2 to 4 lets PostgreSQL retain coarser page/relation-level SIRead locks instead of promoting to many tuple-level locks, reducing lock bookkeeping per GetUserTweets transaction. This is a distinct mechanism from the refuted WAL bundle: it targets lock memory churn, not fsync frequency.
query_effect: GetUserTweets (88% of terminal capacity) should see lower p99 tail as per-transaction SIRead lock bookkeeping shrinks; no change to scan plans.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful_transaction_tps as terminal capacity is freed from lock bookkeeping overhead.
expected_latency_effect: Small decrease in GetUserTweets p99; p50 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Coarser SIRead granularity retains fewer lock entries per transaction.
Less lock bookkeeping shortens the tail of the dominant transaction.
Freed terminal capacity converts to completed transactions.
No blocking exists today; coarsening must not introduce lock waits.

alternatives.statement: Residual wal_wait anomaly (sync 0.13ms, wal_waiting_backends max 1) still caps throughput and predicate-lock tuning is inert.
GetUserTweets is purely client-terminal-bound; no server-side knob moves TPS and only fewer/faster queries help.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves predicate-lock granularity at fine defaults while retries are zero and lock waits are zero; coarsening is a low-risk, non-overlapping lever on the dominant transaction's bookkeeping that the accepted WAL bundle did not touch.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Raise from 2 to 8 within safe [0,256]; 4x coarser page-level SIRead retention without approaching tuple-lock exhaustion.
Raise from -2 to 4 within safe [-2,4096]; positive value caps relation-level locks at 4, coarsening promotion.

nodes.label: Coarser SIRead locking reduces per-txn lock bookkeeping

cross_domain_requirements: If lock_waiting_backends rises above 0, revert granularity coarsening.
